tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bsnyen yig rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/ma lus rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gtum drag khros pa'i gar mdzad gshin rje gshed/
༄༅/ /bsnyen yig rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/ma lus rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gtum drag khros pa'i gar mdzad gshin rje gshed/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsnyen yig rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/

ma lus rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gtum drag khros pa'i gar mdzad gshin rje gshed/ /zhi khro mi yi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /rnam gsum dbyer med bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dir yi dam gyi lha dag gi bsnyen sgrub byed tshul yan lag dang bcas 'chad pa la gsum/ spyi'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa byed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ spyir bsnyen pa de la gnyis yod de/ thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ thun mong mchog gi dbye ba yis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang bla med ltar na bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum ltar na mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad la bsnyen pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang bsnyen pa la lha'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ de'i sngags bzla ba gnyis yod pa las/ snga ma ni gtso bo yin te/ sngags rim chen mo las/ lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang sgrub pa ni bsnyen pa'i gtso bo yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang ngag bzlas la bsnyen pa'i ming btags pa ni/ spyi ming bye brag la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /ci'i phyir bsnyen pa zhes bya zhe na/ rang gi thob bya'am bsgrub bya'i lha de dang khad nye bar byed bas na de skad ces bya'o/ /spyir sngags kyi theg pa'i 'jug sgo ni dbang bskur mtshan nyid pa thob pa nas yin la/ de thob nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bsnyen pa byed pa sngon du 'gro dgos te/ de sngon du ma song bar dbang bskur ba rab gnas sbyin bsreg sogs byar mi rung zhing zhi sogs kyi las kyang 'grub par dka' ba'i phyir te/ sngags rim las/ bsnyen pa sngon du ma song bar dbang la sogs pa la 'jug pa ni rang gis rang la gnon pa byed pa yin te/

zhes dang*/ phreng ba las kyang*/ bsnyen pa med la dngos grub med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag bzlas pa phreng ba dgos pas de'i khyad par ni/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ zhi ba la/ sa dang mu tig dang rus pa dang rdo dang nor bu sogs dang*/ rgyas pa la/ gser dang dngul dang zangs dang byi ru dang tsan+dan dang pad+ma'i sa bon sogs dang*/ dbang la/ gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang las byas pa dang*/ drag po la/ rak+sha dang lung thang dang*/ mi rus sogs las bya bar bshad la/ las thams cad la thun mong du shis pa ni bo de tse yin te de nyid las/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la/ /bo de tse ni las kun byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /grangs ni/ spyir kha sbyor las/ sngags kyi sgrub pa lnga bcu ste/ dbang la de yi phyed nyid do/ / brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ / de bzhin rgyas la lhag pa brgyad/ /mngon spyod la ni bcu drug nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ dmigs bsal nges pa med do/ /gzhan yang sngags rim las/ phreng skud dang*/ phreng ba rab gnas rgyas par bya tshul yang bshad la/ bla med kyi skabs su rab gnas bsdus pa ni/ rang rang gi gsung rdo rjer bskyed par bshad do/ /nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang nas 'byung ba'i/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ye hūṃ zhes pa 'di nang par lan bdun bzlas te phreng ba la btab na 'gyur shin tu che bar bshad pas/ spyir sngags gang bzla ba'i thog mar de bzhin byas na legs la/ kha sbyor sogs las oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dz+nyā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma hā bha be hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho āḥkha swā hā/ zhes bzlas nas phreng ba byin brlab bya ba'i tshul yang bshad do/ /'dren tshul ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi ba la ni mdzub mor bzhag /rgyas la gung mor dgal bar bya/ /ces sogs 'byung ba ltar yin na'ang*/ lag len la khyad par de ltar byed pa'i srol cher mi snang ngo*/ /bzlas pa'i sngon du mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar byed pa ni/

sngags rim nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod na/ de nyid las/ de la thun bzhir bya bar/ kyai rdor dang mngon brjod bla ma sogs kyi rgyud mang po dang mdo bsre sogs kyi bstan bcos mang po las gsungs la/ thun bzhi ni dza lan dha ri pas/ thun bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba ni/ tho rangs dang nyi ma gung dang phyi dro dang mtshan mo ste bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa ltar sman zhabs kyis kyang bshad pas thun bzhi'i byed tshul de ltar ro/ /thun dang po tho rangs kyi thun la sngar bshad pa ltar byas nas thun gzhan gsum la rgyas bsdus khyad par med par bya ba'am mi bya snyam na/ lwa ba pas/ thun dang po la cho ga thams cad spyad nas gung dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams la rang nyid 'od du gyur pa hūṃ du gyur te de yongs su gyur pa la rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas dbang bskur ba phyin chad tshang bar dang thun tha ma la cho ga thams cad byed de dril bu bas kyang de bzhin du bshad do/ /mu tig phreng ba las/ thun gzhan la rang nyid bdag med mar bsgom nas snying kha'i sa bon las 'khor gyi lha mo bcu bzhi phyung ste gnas su bkod nas rnam dag dang sku gsung thugs byin brlab dang dbang bskur ba man chad rnams rdzogs par byed par bshad pa bzhin du nag po spyod pa dang dam tshig rdo rjes kyang kun gzhan la snying kha'i sa bon las 'khor lo spros te 'god pa dang ye shes la gzhug pa dang dbang bskur ba man chad rdzogs par byed par bshad de/ de dag gi bzhed pas gzhal yas khang ma bsdus par yod pas de'i skyed chog dang srung 'khor dang tshogs gsog bzhag nas dang po sbyor ba dran rdzogs byas te dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog thugs ka nas spro ba tsam byas pa'i lugs so/ /phyed bcas bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa las kyang*/ kun mtshams su yang zhes bya ba ni nyi ma gung dang nyi ma'i mtha' dang mtshan phyed la yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yud tsam gyis mngon du byas la/

mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin byas nas gnyid ldog pa'i dus su nyal bar bya'o/ /zhes gsang 'dus la yang de ltar bya bar gsungs te snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /snye ma bcu gnyis pa la/ /'brel bas ni thun gzhan gyi cho ga rjes su bsgrub bo/ /skabs yod na ni mtha' dag bsgrub bo/ /zhes thun dang po la dal na cho ga thams cad dang*/ brel na thun gzhan gyi cho ga ste cho ga bsdus pa bya bar bshad la/ sman zhabs kyis brel na thun dang po la tshang bar bsgoms nas thun gzhan la rang gi gdan la lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas te yi ge gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha spros nas dbang bskur mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bya zhing*/ phra thig gang rung la gnas nas bzlas pa byas te bsdus nas snga ma ltar bya bar gsungs te/ dam tshig rdo rjes bshad pa ltar ye shes pa gzhug dgos pa 'dra'o/ /de ltar na thun thog mtha' gnyis rgyas la bar pa bsdus pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ dang po rgyas la gzhan gsum bsdus pa ni dal brel gyis min gyi/ rgyun pa'i byed lugs so/ /brel bas kyang dang po rgyas pa dang mtha' ma gsum bsdus te byed pa dang*/ thun dang po la yang dal brel gnyis kyi dbang gis rgyas bsdus gnyis byed la gzhan gsum bsdus te byed pa man snye'i lugs rnams las gang rung byas la/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i don ni mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung 'bum thor bu las kyang*/ rgyas bsdus bya tshul de ltar du bshad pa dang*/ mkhas mchog ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi 'khrid yig las kyang*/ thun re re'i nang du long skabs yod na sgrub thabs rgyas pa bsgoms pa grub chen dzā lan dha ri bas bshad pa ltar ram/ yang thun thog mtha' gnyis rgyas la bar pa bsdus pa byed pa grub chen sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar ram/ thun dang po rgyas la mtha' ma gsum bsdus pa grub chen la ba'i na bza' can gyis bshad pa ltar ram/

brel ba byung na bzhi ka bsdus pa byas chog pa grub chen a bh+ya ka ras bshad pa gang rung bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyas bsdus byed pa'i tshe de ltar bya tshul shes dgos las/ de la gong gi lung don zhib bar shes dgos pa yod na'ang mang du dogs nas ma bris shing*/ 'jigs byed la rgyas bsdus ji ltar bya ba cung zad cig 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir byed tshul shes shing blos 'chun na sngar ltar bsdus pa byed pa yang rang bzo min gyi/ mkhas grub tshad ldan du ma'i bzhed pa yin pas byas pa la 'gal ba ci yang med la/ 'on kyang brel ba med pa'i tshe thun bzhi ka'am thog mtha' gnyis la rgyas pa byas na ni legs pa yin te/ sngags rim chen mo las/ dal na la ba pa la sogs pa'i lugs su byas na/ lha bsgom pa'i yun ring ba la khyad che zhing sbyang gzhi sbyong ba'i bskyed rim gyi gnad rnams mi 'chad par snang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bla med kyi skabs su dbang dang rab gnas sbyin bsreg sogs byed rung gi bsten tshad la ni/ brtag gnyis las/ dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi khri yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lwa ba'i na bza' can dang*/ grub chen dpal 'dzin dang*/ rje rin po ches gsungs shing*/ mkhas grub rin po ches rgyud sde spy-i rnams las/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor phal che ba las/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa 'bum/ 'khor rnams la khri khrag re re bya dgos par gsungs/ zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gzhan nas gtso bo'i sngags 'bum sogs bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin bsreg bya bar gsungs pa ni/ sngags rim las/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i skabs la dgongs pa yin pas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byed pa'i snga rol gyi bsnyen pa la de mi dgos par bshad la/ rje'i 'dus pa'i dkyil chog las/ gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor rnams la khri ye shes 'bebs sngags 'bum bzla ba dang de'i bcu cha'i sbyin bsreg bya bar bshad kyang*/

bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin bsreg byed mi byed gsal bar ma bshad sngags rim las ni/ de ma byas kyang chog par bshad ces mkhas grub rin po ches gsungs shing*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi dkyil chog las ni bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin bsreg bya dgos pa gsal bar bshad pas/ rang rang gi lugs kyi khyad par shes dgos so/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor phal cher la ye shes 'bebs sngags khri dang kha skong gi sbyin bsreg ci nus zhig byas na ni legs par mngon te/ dā ri ka pas/ 'bring ngam chung ngu'i tshul gnas na/ /dkyil 'khor dbang po 'bum du ste/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro stong phrag bcu/ /bzlas te lha rnams mchod par bya/ /ye shes mchog la khri phrag ste/ /sbyin bsreg mchog gis nye bar mchod/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags rim sogs nas/ gtso bo'i sngags 'bum mam/ rang gis dbang zhu ba'i skabs su me tog phog pa'i lha gang yin pa de'i sngags 'bum bzla ba 'dam kha can du bshad pas gtso bo'i sngags kyi grangs nges bzung du mi dgos so/ /gtso bo'i sngags bzla na'ang rtsa sngags nges par dgos pa ma yin te snying pos kyang chog par rje yab sras kyis bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs su ni ji ltar bya ba rdo rje 'byung ba las gsungs pa ltar/ sngags rim nas bsnyen pa byed tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bshad pa'i bsdus pa ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lha re re'i bzlas pa 'bum bya bar gsungs la/ kun rig ṭika chen las ni rgyas pa'i dbang du byas nas me tog gang phog gi lha de'i sngags 'bum mam/ yang na rtsa rig 'bum dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams khri phrag re bzla bar bshad cing*/ ye shes 'bebs sngags bzla dgos mi dgos mi gsal la/ rje nyid kyis kyang 'dir gsal bar bshad pa mi snang bas 'bebs sngags bzla ba'am ma bzlas kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ spro na/ lhan thabs zhig nas gtso bo'i sngags 'bum dang 'khor rnams la khri ye shes 'bebs sngags 'bum sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa bya bar bshad pa ltar byas na'ang legs/

ye shes 'bebs sngags ni/ kha cig gsang 'dus nas bshad pa de yin zhes bzhed kyang*/ kho bo ltar na ni rang rang gi skabs nas bshad pa'i ye shes 'bebs tshul de ka yin snyam ste brtag /de'i phyir kun rig gi sgo nas gzhan don byed par 'dod pas ni rab sngar bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ ma tha'ang gzung thung 'bum phrag gcig nges par bzla dgos kyi/ gzhan du na nyes pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /gtso bo'i sngags ni/ rab rtsa rig dang de min na'ang*/ gzugs thung gis kyang chog par sems bzlas pa'i tshe thun dang po la cho ga rdzogs par byas nas/ thun gyi mthar yig brgya brjod pa'i rjes su gtso bo las byed nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug cing phyi ma gsum la 'jug pa'i tshe/ gtso bo'i dam rgya bcings nas sngags brjod de gtso bo dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ mchod bstod byas nas bzlas pa la zhugs chog par bshad pas/ tshe ka slar 'don dgos pa ni min no/ /spyod rgyud dang chung bas 'dir bzhag la/ bya rgyud la ni legs grub las/ /bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la/ /spyir na yi ge du yod pa/ /de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ /bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad/ /de bas mang ba'i yi ge la/ /sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing 'bum bzla bar yang bshad pas gang rung ngo*/ /'di la gtso bo ma gtogs 'khor gyi bsnyen pa mi dgos pas/ bdag bskyed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bcas sam gtso rkyang bskyed pas kyang chog go /rgyud sde bzhi gang gi skabs su yang*/ bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe lha'i gnang ba thob na/ bzlas pa'i grangs ma rdzogs kyang des go chod la/ gnas gcig tu bsnyen pa'i grangs rdzogs dgos kyi/ gnas gzhan du byed dang*/ de las gzhan du phyed bzlas nas grangs rdzogs kyang bsnyen pa'i grangs rdzogs pa'i go mi chod cing thun gyi tshe yang sems g.yeng nas bzlas pa bsnyen pa'i grangs la mi 'dren par bshad/

thun 'go nas mjug gi bar ring thung ni rang gi khams la dpag ste bya'i/ ha cang ring na sun pa dang*/ ha cang thung na sngags pa zla long med par ji ltar 'tsham par bya'o/ /thun dngos gzhi'i skabs su gtam smra ba dang bza' btung dang 'phro ba'i bya ba mi bya la/ thun mtshams su ni/ smra 'chad bya ba'am ma byas kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ smra dgos na mtshams g.yog pa dngos sam/ mtshams 'og tu chud par byas pa lta bu ma gtogs gzhan dang ngag bsre bar ma byas na legs la/ 'on kyang bde mtshams la ni nges pa med do/ /bla ma gcig bde mtshams yin na/ lha gzhan bsgom pa dang de'i sngags bzla ba sogs rung yang*/ mtshams dam par byed tshe lha de'i mngon rtogs sogs dang yig brgya dang lha bla ma'i bstod pa lta bu ma gtogs/ lha gzhan gyi mngon rtogs dang bzlas brjod ni dngos gzhi'i skabs su ma zad thun 'tshams su yang mi bya bar bshad la/ 'on kyang mkhas grub rin po ches ni/ nyin gcig la dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba bzhi'i bsnyen pa bya rung bar bzhed cing*/ nyin gcig thun bzhi la de ltar byed pa ni/ rgya gzhung na mi gsal yang*/ bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes su dga' ba la lha du mas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin par bshad cing*/ byed lugs kyang de'i gsung 'bum nas 'byung ba ltar shes dgos/ mthun gyi ring zas gos sogs grib can gi rigs la 'dzem dgos shing*/ kha blta phyogs ni/

rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ byang du kha bltas rgyas pa'i las/ /de bzhin zhi ba shar du blta/ /drag po'i las la lho yi phyogs/ /dbang gi las la nub tu blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ram/ ma bden phyogs rtog sas btags pa tsam du bsams la gang bde bya/ rdo rje 'am g.yung drung lta bus mtshon pa'i stan la spyod lam tshul dang mthun par 'khod de/ 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar 'dod dang*/ chos 'di lta bu bsgrub tu yod pa ni skal ba bzang snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ de'i tshe rtags mtshan bzang ngan gang byung yang re dogs mi bya zhing*/ bzang po byung na 'ang rlom sems dang ngan pa la'ang rnam rtog byar mi rung ngo*/ /tho bzhi rgya chen bzhir bskyed pa ni/ rje yab sras kyi gsung las bshad pa ma mthong yang*/ bla ma 'ga' zhig gis bshad pas bya ba'am ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ 'on kyang thun 'dzug pa'i thog mar bgegs gtor gtong ba sogs byas na legs shing*/ ma grub na/ yungs kar la drag sngags btab ste/ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bgegs bskrad tsam bya bar bshad/ bla med kyi skabs thun mtshams su gang zag rtogs pa mthon po la sha chang sgog gtsong sogs ma bkag na'ang so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pas ni/ dam rdzas yin pa'i 'du shes kyis nang mchod myang ba tsam ma gtogs/ chang la sred pa'i yid kyis 'thung gtan nas mi rung*/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs su sha chang sogs la longs spyod du mi rung shing gtsang sbra la gnas pa gal che/ gtor ma ni/ thun bzhi ka'i mtha' grub na rab/ ma grub na thun phyi ma'i mthar 'bul dgos la/ gzhan ji ltar bya ba ni rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa byed tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ 'di'i che ba/ rten dang*/ gnas dang*/ yo byad sogs kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ni lnga ste/ spyir yi dam 'di la brten na 'tshang rgya ba la bgegs kyis mi tshugs shing byin rlabs myur ba'i khyad chos rgyu ma dang me thab gnyis kyis 'dus pa nas bshad pa'i sgyu lus dang 'od gsal mtshon pa'i khyad chos/

kha ṭ+wāṃ kas 'khor lo bde mchog dang kyai rdor nas bshad pa'i bde stong ston pa'i khyad chos/ me thab kyis shes rab gzhan las che zhing sdigs mdzub kyis dngos grub myur ba dang skyes bu gsal shing la bskyod pas ni sdig can btsan thabs su tshang rgya bar nus pa'i khyad chos/ rje btsun spyir rgyal ba kun gyi yab yin zhing*/ khyad par 'jigs byed la rgyu 'bras ye shes sems dpa' gsum ka'i skabs su 'jam dpal gyi zhal dngos su yod pas tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rten sgrub pa po dad pa che zhing byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang sbyin sogs kyi spyod pa dang ldan zhing gzhan don la dngos su brtson pa'am de dag phyogs mthun yod pa dang*/ khyad par du 'di'i dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pa zhig dgos/ gsum pa ni/ gnas shing drung ngam dur khrod sogs rgyud nas bshad pa ltar ram/ rang gi yid dang mthun pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ mchod rdzas spyi dang*/ khyad par bris sku dang*/ rdor dril/ nang mchod sogs sta gon bya zhing bgegs bskrad/ bdud rtsi ril bu'am nang mchod kyis kha dag par bya/ sa m+bha ra sogs 'gyur sngags 'don cing*/ ngag byin gyis rlob na/ oṃ a ā nas/ k+ṣa ¿hūṃ swā hā zhes pa'i bar lan bdun brjod/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du 'gro bas 'dod na bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung ngam/ gsol 'debs ci rigs bya/ de nas thun dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung ste nyer bsdu'i bar mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar rim par bsgom/ phyi ma gsum gyi che tshogs zhing nas bya la/ bskyed tshul bsdus pa byed na/ bdag med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i re mig dgu pa'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/

zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs su lha bcu gsum gyi skur yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po nas/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po yab yum nas/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu yab yum/ nang gi shar lhor tsa rtsi ka dkar mo yab yum/ nas/ byang shar du go ri ljang khu yab yum/ gwa bzhir mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi/ zhes dal bus brjod cing bsams la mngal 'byin byas te/ phyogs skyong dgug bskyed dor nas skye mched byin rlabs kyang bsdu zhing*/ de man chad ni gzhung ltar rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ dag pa dran par ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ gong du drangs pa'i sngags rim gyi don ltar na/ de las kyang bsdu tshul zhig snang yang 'dir ma bris te/ kha cig ha cang sla chos byed par dogs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyas bsdus gang byas kyang yid la shar bsgom bya zhing*/ nga rgyal dang gsal snang brtan po'am/ lhag tu'ang de dang de'i mos pa shugs can bya dgos te/ gsal snang dang nga rgyal gnyis las nga rgyal gtso bo yin par rje nyid kyi bshad pas/ tshig tsam brjod pa lhur mi byed do/ / thun dang po'i tshe dag pa dran pa'i rjes su phreng ba gsung rdo rje bskyed pa sogs bya la/ phyi ma gsum gyi tshe byed dam ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub la mang yang thun mong ba tsam byed na/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i nyi gdan zla gdan dang hūṃ yig hrīḥyig tu gyur ba'i mthar oṃ a ra pa tsa nas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang mi shes pa dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad la thob/ de rnams kyi mi shes pa sogs sbyangs nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer las 'phros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos rgyal ba sras bcas rnams mchod cing*/

de dag gi mkhyen rab thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ shes rab kyi snang ba khyad par can thob par bsams la/ yig 'bum mam/ 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ yang na ci nus bzla/ rtsa sngags sogs bzla ba'i tshe zla gdan nyi gdan dang dhīḥyig hūṃ yig tu gyur pa'i mthar/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du ya man+ta ka /hrīḥṣ+tīḥya ma rā dza rnams kha dog sngo nag 'od zer 'phro ba'i rnam par bkod nas hūṃ dang sngags 'phreng la yid gtad de/ ha cang myur bu la sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar bzla zhing*/ phreng ba lha 'gug pa'i dmigs pas bgrang*/ sngags gsum ka la bsnyen pa byed na/ rtsa sngags nas thog mar bzla ba'am/ ya mān+ta ka nas thog mar bzla ba gang bde yin par gsungs shing*/ lag len du rtsa sngags nas thog mar byed pa dang*/ gsum po gang rung zhig la grangs bsnyen byed na/ sngags gsum ka 'god pa'am gang bzla ba de kho na bkod kyang chog par bshad cing*/ gsum ka bkod na snga ma bzlas zin pa na phyi ma la thim par bsam pa gang bde/ bar bar du dbugs dang lhan cig spro bsdu bya zhing*/ de yang dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs sam/ 'od zer rtsa zhal gyi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ sems can gyi don byas/ dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig slar 'dus nas sngags 'phreng la thim zhing*/ zhal dgu dang lha thams cad kyi zhal nas 'don par bsam/ rtsa sngags thog mar 'don pa gtso bor byed na de gang mang dang gzhan nyer gcig sogs cig 'grub de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang sbyar zhing rtsa sngags 'grub tu nye ba'i tshe yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla ba sogs bya/ sngags gsum po gang rung zhig yin na gang bzla ba de ci mang dang gzhan gang 'grub/ de yang hrīḥṣ+tīḥyin na rtsa sngags sam ya mān+ta ka'i rjes su 'don pa'i khyad par ma gtogs 'dra la/ 'on kyang gang gtso bor bzla ba de sngon la bzlas chog par ni bshad do/ /grangs ni/ bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/

'di ni ma he'i gdong can gyi/ /snying po'i sngags su rab tu grags/ /yi ge re re 'bum bzlas pas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi las ni gang*/ /ci yang rung ba thams cad byed/ / ces ya mān+ta ka yig 'bum dang*/ las kyi sngags su rab tu grags/ /sum 'bum bzlas pas las kun byed/ ces/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥsum 'bum dang*/ ma he'i gdong can rtsa sngags te/ /'bum bzlas pa yis las kun byed/ /ces rtsa sngags 'bum bzla bar bshad cing*/ de yang zhi sogs kyi las bsgrub pa'i skabs la dgongs pa ste dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin bsreg sogs bya ba la/ gsum ka'am yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na chog par yang bshad pas skabs dang bstun cing*/ da lta'i gang zag gis las mang po 'grub pa la ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa sa ya'am byai ba lta bu 'gro dgos par bshad do/ /rtog gsum gyi lung sngar drangs pa ltar/ rje'i za ma tog las kyang*/ ya mān+ta ka snying por bshad cing*/ bla ma kha cig de snying po dang*/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥnye snying du bzhed la/ lcang skya zhabs sogs mang pos ni de las bzlog ste bshad pas brtag /'khor gyi sngags grangs ni khri yin la/ bzla ba'i tshe bum la sogs pa'i thugs kar nyi gdan la rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sngags rnams g.yas skor du 'greng ste 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du blta zhing*/ sdang bzhin gtso 'khor thams cad kyis 'don par bsams te bzlas na 'gyur che bar bshad/ bzlas pa rnams song nas sngags de dag ci 'grub bzlas pa'i rjes su/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ'i 'jug tu/ a be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya/ hūṃ haḥ.āḥdzhaihūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i ye shes 'bebs sngags gang mang bzla ste/ grangs ni khri phrag gcig go /yang na hrīḥṣ+tīḥ'i 'jug tu hūṃ haḥ.āḥdzhai hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags pa ni ye shes 'bebs sngags bsdus pa yin zhes bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi lus la char chen po 'bebs pa bzhin thim par bsam/ thun gyi mthar yig brgya mchod bstod gtor 'bul nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ 'dir las gshin la'ang gtor 'bul byed pa gal che'o/ /gsum pa 'phros don gtor ma'i rim pa la/ de'i rgyu ni sngags rim las/ gtor ma'i rdzas ni zan dang sran ma dang sha dang nya sha dang chan thug dang khur ba dang chang dang chu dang gtsong dang sgog skya dang 'o ma la sogs pa'am/ ma 'byor na zan dang chu la sogs pa tsam yang rung bar phreng ba dang man snye las bshad do/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bya zhing*/ bla med kyi skabs su chang ni gtor rdzas kyi gtso bo yin par bshad/ gtor ma'i dbyibs ji ltar bya ba ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung 'bum e waṃ las/ ye dam sogs kyi gtor ma'i dbyibs ni rgyud rgya gzhung sogs las gsal bar bshad pa mi 'dug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rje yab sras kyi gsung las kyang gsal bar bshad pa mi snang bas/ gong gi rdzas de rnams 'bul rung bar mngon la/ 'on kyang paṇa chen rin po ches 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma'i dbyibs rtse mo zur gsum la rtsa ba cung zad zlum pa snying gzugs kyi rnam pa can du bya bar bshad cing*/ lcang skya zhabs kyis kyang dbyibs snying gzugs lta bu la dmar rtsis brgyan pa'i mthar gong gi rdzas de rnams gang rung 'jog par bshad pas de lta bya/ phyag len 'ga' zhig la zlum po tsam dang de la gshog pa 'dogs pa'i tshul gnyis snang zhing*/ gang ltar yang gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs bla med phal cher la ni zlum po cung zad ldir che zhing dmar rtsis brgyan par byas na 'thad par sems la/ de yang drag po yin na me ri sogs dang bcas shing zhi ba la ni me ri dor na legs snyam/ 'on kyang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gtor dbyibs ni mkhas grub rin po ches bshad cing chos skyong drag po la ni zur gsum byed pa dar ro/

/gzhan gtor ma bya tshul gyi dpe zhig snang ba ni phyag len ye ger bkod pa yin gyi/ rgyud rgya gzhung dang mkhas grub dam pa'i gsung nas dngos su bshad pa min par rtogs so/ /rgyud sde 'og ma'i gtor rdzas ni/ zan dang khur ba dang chan thug dang chu dang 'o ma sogs bya zhing*/ dbyibs ni zlum po dkar rtses brgyan pa la skor rgyan byas na 'thad par bzhed/ 'on kyang skabs stobs kyis khyad par 'byed dgos shing*/ phyag len la gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs la sked dkris lta bu zhig byed par snang la/ de yang kha cig pad 'dab kyi dbyibs lta bu dang*/ de las skyes pa'i rnam par byed dgos zer ba sogs mang yang tshad ldan gyi gzhung nas bshad pa ma mthong bas/ de yod dam med kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ 'bul ba'i snod ni/ sngags rim las/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud las kyang khyogs sam zangs gzhong gi snod du bya bar bshad la/ phreng bar kham phor dang khyor bar yang sbyin par bshad pas ci rigs so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snod bzang po gang yang rung ba'o/ / bskyed chog ni sngags rim las rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi lugs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bshad kyang rang rang gi cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ spyi 'gro yang yod pas de bzhin du bya'o/ /skabs gang du 'bul ba ni/ bsnyen pa'i 'jug tu yig brgya dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus zhig bya ba'i mthar ram/ yig brgya bzlas pa'i mjug nyid du 'ang rung la/ spyir bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i mjug gam/ rang nyid skad cig gis lha de dang der bskyed nas 'bul yul gang yin pa de la phul kyang chog /'bul ba'i yul ni/ bdag bskyed rkyang ba'i skabs su mdun du bskyed cing ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim nas 'bul ba'am/ skad cig gis spyan 'dren tsam byas nas 'bul la/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su de nyid la 'bul rung*/ 'jigs byed la ni bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig yin na bdag bskyed la 'bul rung yang*/

bsnyen pa'i skabs su mdun du bskyed pa'am/ spyan drangs pa tsam byas nas 'bul dgos kyi/ bdag bskyed nyid la 'bul ba ni rje'i dgongs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir bsnyen pa'i tshe mngon rtogs dngos gzhi'i skabs su phyogs skyong dgug bskyed byed pa ni mi 'thad pas/ de'i mjug tu bya'o/ / gtor mgron gyi lha bskyed tshul sogs la rgyas bsdus mang du yod pa ni gzhan nas shes par bya zhing*/ 'jigs byed la de byed tshul gyi khyad par zhig bdag gis gzhan du bshad zin to/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni gal che ba'ang yin te/ sngags rim chen mo las/ gtor ma ni rgyud rnams las bgegs nye bar zhi ba dang dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir thog ma dang tha mar gal che bar gsungs pas bya dgos la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /smras pa/ rgyud sde gong 'og dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha yi bsnyen pa byed tshul sogs/ /dam pa'i gzhung la brten nas ni/ /don bsdus go sla'i ngag gis bshad/ /ces bya'o/ /bsnyen yig rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ dad pa dang rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gnas brtan grags pa dpal 'byor gyis nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa snga mas mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig 'ga' re snang yang*/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar bya tshul sngags rim chen mo nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal bar bshad pa mi 'dug pas/ 'dir de byed tshul dang bcas te gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas sbyar ba'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bsnyen yig rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 42--PAGE 41--PAGE 25-
